title: Paris Catacombs
summary: The Paris Catacombs are a large network of underground tunnels that extend deep beneath the city of Paris. Joan of Arc hid the Ring of Arc here where it remained for many centuries until it was recovered by the Huntik Foundation.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The catacombs were originally rock quarries but were eventually turned into tombs where they buried their dead. [Divide and Conquer]

During the French Revolution, some soldiers and an archeologist became trapped when they took refuge in the catacombs. Their skeletons would later be found by Lok Lambert and Cherit. [Divide and Conquer]

Joan of Arc hid the Ring of Arc, containing the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc, within the tunnels and left the Knights of Arc's Inner Circle to guard it. [Crawling the Catacombs]

While on his quest to find the Amulet of Will, Eathon Lambert explored the catacombs, and hid his Titan, Springer, in a puzzle within a trapped alcove for his son, Lok, to eventually find. [Crawling the Catacombs] [Huntik.com]

Following clues left by Joan of Arc, the Huntik team entered the catacombs through a passage in the abandoned church in Paris and fought the Knights of Arc's Inner Circle to recover the Ring of Arc. They made a plan to smuggle the cursed ring out of the Catacombs via Gareon, and evade DeFoe and his Organization forces, and safely deliver it to the Foundation safehouse at the Cathedral of Notre Dame. [Divide and Conquer]

The Ring of Arc eventually broke free and kidnapped Clements, trapping him in a dream state and retuning to the catacombs where it had resided for centuries. The Huntik team ventured into the catacombs to rescue him, where they touched the Ring and found themselves trapped in dreamworlds. Lok and Dante managed to escape and faced off against Arc, now revealed as as the Titan of Fate, and defeated her. [S2E34]
